package.name: mujoco_digital_twin
package.description: MuJoCo-simulated digital twin: a standalone ROS2 Python node that subscribes /hw_command and publishes /hw_status with real physics (via MuJoCo), as a drop-in replacement for hw_interface_node's ROS contract when you want simulated dynamics instead of hw_interface's kinematic dummy backends. Requires the `mujoco` pip package (not a rosdep/apt dependency - see README).
